banner: exploratory: reference is the majority of LLM annotators (3 models + 1 AI workbook of unknown model, not independent); there is no human validation

interpretations.status: confirmed normative clarification of SqlVizSpec-v1.0.0 (E02, issues #2 #3 #36)

annotator_independence: NOT independent: pilot_claude and claude_single_pass are the same model family; ai_workbook_unknown_model is an AI of unknown identity; none is human
truth_rule: plurality over four annotators; unique-top required; ties listed and excluded
class_balance_caveat: largest class share in the reference = 0.71; accuracy is dominated by it and macro-F1 over a handful of rare-class items is unstable
